entities.label: Text
entities.summary: Vedanga Jyotisha, or Jyotishavedanga, is one of earliest known Indian texts on astrology (Jyotisha). The extant text is dated to the final centuries BCE, but it may be based on a tradition reaching back to about 700-600 BCE.
